What changed between two published Players Committee images of [[Escape Pod & We're Doomed]]: left, the image of [[Escape Pod & We're Doomed (Errata)]] (holotable commit b4a011a); right, the image of [[Escape Pod & We're Doomed (Errata 2)]] (holotable commit e8445f0). Both crops are cut from the published images ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/b4a011ace2799d9e188578c4043193ff94a7a06c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/large/escapepodweredoomed.gif before], [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e8445f08fa931119eec2c3f95d5cea095145da26/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/large/escapepodweredoomed.gif after]) with their pixels unchanged; only the white label strip is added.
